# appdynamics_health_rule_violations (Data Source)

Queries AppDynamics health rule violations (incidents) for an application within a time range. This is a reporting/lookup query over historical data, not a list of currently-managed config objects -- results change over time as new violations occur, and re-running the same query later can return different results even with identical arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A query over historical data, not a list of managed config -- results
# change over time as new violations occur.
data "appdynamics_health_rule_violations" "recent" {
  application_id   = 42
  time_range_type  = "BEFORE_NOW"
  duration_in_mins = 1440 # last 24 hours
}

output "open_violation_names" {
  value = [for v in data.appdynamics_health_rule_violations.recent.violations : v.name if v.incident_status != "RESOLVED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to query violations for.
- `time_range_type` (String) BEFORE_NOW, AFTER_TIME, or BETWEEN_TIMES. See the AppDynamics Events API docs.

### Optional

- `duration_in_mins` (Number) Required when time_range_type is BEFORE_NOW or AFTER_TIME.
- `end_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES.
- `start_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES or AFTER_TIME.

### Read-Only

- `violations` (Attributes List) The health rule violations matching the query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--violations))

<a id="nestedatt--violations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `violations`

Read-Only:

- `deep_link_url` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `end_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds.
- `id` (String)
- `incident_status` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `start_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds.
